provenance: Real Chrome/Edge browser keyboard and mouse input against file:// release, offline browser contexts. No state injection. Human playtesting has not been performed.
limitations: Headless and headed tab switches both required synthetic blur fallback; physical OS Alt+Tab/minimize is unverified.
Viewport/DPR and fit resizing are tested; actual browser Ctrl+/- zoom is unverified.
Human playtesting, audio listening, G1-G4 gameplay and G4 long-duration performance are unexecuted.
